text: RESULTS: MRCP demonstrates a dilated common bile duct with an abrupt cut-off, consistent with extrahepatic biliary obstruction. speaker: Doctor
text: The "double duct sign" on the MRCP is highly suggestive of a pancreatic head or periampullary malignancy, even though the CT was initially read as normal. I will request endoscopic ultrasound for tissue diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Endoscopic Ultrasound with Fine Needle Aspiration.

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative EUS-FNA is puzzling given the classic double duct sign, so I must rule out benign strictures or other causes.
